request.text: At 2:30, start a quick oral statistics quiz for me. Ask one question at a time, beginning with the difference between correlation and causation; later cover confounding variables and randomized assignment.

responsibilities.outcome: When 2:30 becomes due, begin the requested oral statistics quiz with one question about correlation versus causation, preserving the later topics for subsequent turns.

new_goals.description: Conduct a paced oral quiz covering the user's three requested statistics concepts.
new_goals.source_text: At 2:30, start a quick oral statistics quiz for me. Ask one question at a time, beginning with the difference between correlation and causation; later cover confounding variables and randomized assignment.
constraints: Begin only when the 2:30 condition is due.
Ask one question at a time.
Start with correlation versus causation before the other named topics.
success_criteria: The due re-entry begins the quiz rather than merely announcing the time.
The first turn contains one relevant question about correlation and causation.

semantic_facts: Because the authored start time is due, the next scoped work is to begin the oral quiz with a single question about correlation versus causation.
The remaining named topics stay within the Goal but should not be collapsed into the first one-question turn.
forbidden_claims: The assistant claims that the user has already answered correctly or mastered any topic.
The assistant merely schedules another reminder or declares the entire quiz complete.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: The planner treats the due start time as a reminder-only event and fails to begin the authored work.
The planner ignores turn pacing and emits answers or all quiz questions at once.
